candidates.title: build-receipt-capture
candidates.description: Photograph a receipt and store it against an expense.
candidates.rationale: The PRODUCT's own scope (PS-001), decomposed once from concept.json.
candidates.user_visible_outcome: A user can photograph a receipt and see it attached to the expense.

assumptions.statement: the device camera API returns a usable image on the target OS versions

candidates.verification_plan: Photograph a real receipt on a real device and confirm it renders on the expense.

candidates.title: build-mileage-claims
candidates.description: Claim mileage for a journey and roll it into the same expense report.
candidates.rationale: The PRODUCT's own scope (PS-002), decomposed once from concept.json. Killed at step-0: the blocking assumption FAILED (every route needed a paid mapping API), and no risk-free fallback was found.
candidates.user_visible_outcome: A driver can claim a journey and see it on the same report as their receipts.

assumptions.statement: journey distance can be derived without a paid mapping API

candidates.verification_plan: Claim a real journey and confirm the distance matches the odometer.
